'''VKBT''' (Van Kush Beauty Token) and '''CURE''' are Hive-Engine tokens issued from the Van Kush Family business, a maker of handcrafted goods. They have been in distribution for several years.

== Significance to MELEK ==
MELEK has not been listed on any external exchange and has no trading pair outside its own infrastructure. As a consequence there is no route into MELEK from Bitcoin, Litecoin, STEEM or HIVE.

VKBT and CURE are bridged from Hive-Engine onto [[PRANA Blockchain|PRANA]] one-to-one under multisignature custody, and traded on [[KulaSwap]] as VKBT/KULA and CURE/KULA against a KULA/MELEK pair. They are therefore the only assets carrying outside value that reach MELEK, in either direction:

* ''Inbound'' — a holder of VKBT or CURE can convert into KULA and then MELEK.
* ''Outbound'' — a holder of MELEK can convert to KULA, then to VKBT or CURE, then across the bridge to Hive-Engine and out through HIVE or a swap withdrawal.
